name: net_one_brain_phantom_leave
description: VUH-2292: three default loopback players in HB 04/15 btl 26. Withdraw the host until its original Phantom leaves, then return for a native refill. Require a living Magic Phantom escape followed by a same-point refill. The old ID must leave without a live relabel, both friends must have a fresh unmatched=0 sample within 2 seconds of the host refill, and the refill must bind separately. Finish with HP parity and a shared room clear (VUH-2272/2302/2304).

steps.expr: location(0)==[4, 21, 0, 1, 26, 32767] and location(1)==location(0) and location(2)==location(0) and all(any(a['name']=='P_EX100' for a in actors(i)) for i in range(3))
all(any(a['objectId']==2403 and a['hp']>0 for a in enemies(i)) for i in range(3)) and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1) and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(2)
[[a['address'] for a in enemies(i) if a['objectId']==2403 and a['hp']>0] for i in range(3)]

[sorted([(a['name'], a.get('objectType'), a.get('objectId'), a.get('motionId'), [round(a['position'][k]) for k in ('x', 'y', 'z')] if a.get('position') else None) for a in actors(i) if a['name'].startswith('F_')]) for i in range(3)]
not any(a['address'] in saved['first_phantoms'][0] for a in enemies(0))
len(log_matches(r'refilled at its point netId=(?P<id>\d+) objectId=2403 left=1 frame=(?P<frame>\d+) beforeManifest=1 tickMs=(?P<tick>\d+)', 0)) >= 1
log_matches(r'refilled at its point netId=(?P<id>\d+) objectId=2403 left=1 frame=(?P<frame>\d+) beforeManifest=1 tickMs=(?P<tick>\d+)', 0)[0]
all(log_count('client: host leave netId '+saved['phantom_outcome']['id']+' objectId 2403 applied', i) >= 1 for i in (1, 2))
enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1) and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(2)
all(not any(a['address'] in saved['first_phantoms'][i] for a in enemies(i)) for i in (1,2))
steps.message: The original escaped friend actors must be absent after native disposal

steps.expr: [log_matches(r'\[enemy-binding\] epoch=\d+ frame=(?P<frame>\d+) spawn=\d+ actor=(?P<actor>[0-9A-F]+) [^\r\n]*objectId=2403 prior=\d+ floor=\d+ candidate=(?P<id>\d+) selected=(?P<selected>\d+) reason=(?P<reason>[^ ]+)', i) for i in (1, 2)]
[log_matches(r'\[statehash\] role=\w+ epoch=\d+ frame=(?P<frame>\d+) room=04/15 [^\r\n]*count=\d+ unmatched=(?P<u>\d+) observed=\d+ tickMs=(?P<tick>\d+)', i) for i in (1, 2)]

all(any(b['id']==saved['phantom_outcome']['id'] and b['selected']==b['id'] and b['reason']=='established-death' for b in saved['refill_bindings'][i]) and any(int(h['u'])==0 and 0<=int(h['tick'])-int(saved['phantom_outcome']['tick'])<=2000 for h in saved['refill_hashes'][i]) for i in range(2))
steps.message: Both friends need unmatched=0 within 2 seconds of the host Phantom refill

steps.expr: all(any(old['id']==saved['phantom_outcome']['id'] and old['selected']==old['id'] and old['reason']=='established-death' and any(int(new['selected'])>int(old['id']) and new['reason']=='newest-live-point' and int(new['frame'])>int(old['frame']) and new['actor']!=old['actor'] for new in rows) for old in rows) for rows in saved['refill_bindings'])
steps.message: Both friends must bind a fresh replacement Phantom to the newer host ID

steps.expr: all(log_count('live-body-id-relabel-refused', i)==0 for i in (1, 2))

steps.expr: [sorted((a['objectId'], a['hp']) for a in enemies(i) if a.get('hp', 0) > 0) for i in range(3)]

[log_count('objectId 2407 @', i) for i in (1, 2)]
